### Read H3K27me3

ROIs: mm10_TSS_1kb_noStrandID_unique.bed (24,313 rows)

```{r}
df_D2_TKO_H3_H3K27me3 <- read.table("../H3K27me3_H3k4me3/result_H3K27me3/RNASeq_D2_TKO_H3_H3K27me3.tab")
df_D2_TKO_H3_H3K27me3<- dplyr::rename(df_D2_TKO_H3_H3K27me3,c("Gene"= "V1", "size"="V2","covered"="V3","sum"="V4","D2_TKO_H3_H3K27me3"="V5","mean"="V6"))
df_D2_TKO_H3_H3K27me3 <- df_D2_TKO_H3_H3K27me3 %>%  dplyr::select(Gene, D2_TKO_H3_H3K27me3)


df_D2_TKO_K4M_H3K27me3 <- read.table("../H3K27me3_H3k4me3/result_H3K27me3/RNASeq_D2_TKO_K4M_H3K27me3.tab")
df_D2_TKO_K4M_H3K27me3<- dplyr::rename(df_D2_TKO_K4M_H3K27me3,c("Gene"= "V1", "size"="V2","covered"="V3","sum"="V4","D2_TKO_K4M_H3K27me3"="V5","mean"="V6"))
df_D2_TKO_K4M_H3K27me3 <- df_D2_TKO_K4M_H3K27me3 %>%  dplyr::select(Gene, D2_TKO_K4M_H3K27me3)


df_D2_WT_H3_H3K27me3 <- read.table("../H3K27me3_H3k4me3/result_H3K27me3/RNASeq_D2_WT_H3_H3K27me3.tab")
df_D2_WT_H3_H3K27me3<- dplyr::rename(df_D2_WT_H3_H3K27me3,c("Gene"= "V1", "size"="V2","covered"="V3","sum"="V4","D2_WT_H3_H3K27me3"="V5","mean"="V6"))
df_D2_WT_H3_H3K27me3 <- df_D2_WT_H3_H3K27me3 %>%  dplyr::select(Gene, D2_WT_H3_H3K27me3)


df_D2_WT_K4M_H3K27me3 <- read.table("../H3K27me3_H3k4me3/result_H3K27me3/RNASeq_D2_WT_K4M_H3K27me3.tab")
df_D2_WT_K4M_H3K27me3<- dplyr::rename(df_D2_WT_K4M_H3K27me3,c("Gene"= "V1", "size"="V2","covered"="V3","sum"="V4","D2_WT_K4M_H3K27me3"="V5","mean"="V6"))
df_D2_WT_K4M_H3K27me3 <- df_D2_WT_K4M_H3K27me3 %>%  dplyr::select(Gene,D2_WT_K4M_H3K27me3)
```

```{r}
clean_NoDiff <- function(df, colname) {
  df[[colname]][df[[colname]] == "NaN"] <- "n.s."
  return(df)
}
```

## Boxplot 

#### TKO_H3 vs WT_H3: H3K27me3
```{r}
p <- ggplot(df_TKO_H3_D2_vs_WT_H3_D2, aes(fill = thresh_adjp005_fc1_TKO.H3.D2_vs_WT.H3.D2, x = thresh_adjp005_fc1_TKO.H3.D2_vs_WT.H3.D2, y = log2((D2_TKO_H3_H3K27me3+1)/(D2_WT_H3_H3K27me3+1))))+
    geom_boxplot(na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(UP = "red", DOWN = "blue", n.s. = "grey"),  guide = "none")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(UP = "Up", DOWN = "Down", n.s. = "n.s.")) +
  xlab(NULL)+
  ylab("LogFC (H3K27me3)")+
  theme_minimal()
p
```

```{r}
#p+pdf("Boxplot_H3K27me3/TKO_H3_D2_vs_WT_H3_D2_H3K27me3.pdf",width = 8, height = 6)
```
